title: Unit-normalized affine tensor sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module, $U,V$ affine objects of its small etale site, and $a:V\to U$ a morphism [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison-hom-normalization]. Set $A=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ and $C=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$, with the algebra structure induced by $a$. There exists an additive equivalence $\Gamma(U,U^*\mathcal F)\otimes_A C\cong\Gamma(V,V^*\mathcal F)$ taking $m\otimes b$ to $b\cdot\rho_a(m)$, where $\rho_a$ is the unit-normalized restriction [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial].

proof.text: Transport quasi-coherence from ordinary pullback to tensorPullback U.hom using uniqueness of left adjoints. Apply exists_affineTopTensorSections to a.left and G = tensorPullback U.hom F, then compose its bijective additive map with the normalized etale section transport equivalence. For pure tensors, use congrArg on the affine formula and the transport scalar equation.

theorem exists_etaleAffineTensorSectionsEquiv
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U V : X.Etale) (a : V ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hV : IsAffine V.left) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(V.left, ⊤) := a.left.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ e : (Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤) ⊗[Γ(U.left, ⊤)]
      Γ(V.left, ⊤)) ≃+ Γ((Modules.tensorPullback V.hom).obj F, ⊤),
      ∀ (m : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤)) (b : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
        e (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(U.left, ⊤)] b) = b • Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F a m
